Implement integer-cent parsing of -?DIGITS[.D[D]] (never zero), two-decimal output with leading
minus and no separators, code/name/memo validators, real calendar date check, and a guard that
computes the resulting per-account balances for a proposed change set before any write.

validate_code accepts 1 to 12 characters of A-Z and 0-9 and rejects everything else.
Names and memos enforce their length bounds and forbid comma and newline.
validate_date accepts real YYYY-MM-DD dates and rejects impossible or malformed ones.
balance_guard accepts a change that keeps every balance at or above zero, rejects one that goes below, and writes nothing.
balance_guard rejects when any one account in the change set would go negative.
The core module uses no float literal and no float conversion.
